questions.question: When x is subtracted from each of 21, 22, 60 and 64, the numbers so obtained in this order, are in proportion, what is the mean proportional between (x - 2) and (2x + 8)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The numbers = 21, 22, 60, and 64

**Calculation:**

According to the question

⇒ {21 - xover 22 - x} = {60 - xover 64 - x}

By dividendo and componendo

⇒ 1344 - 64x - 21x + x² = 1320 - 22x - 60x + x²

⇒ 3x = 24

⇒ x = 8

The mean proportion = √{(x - 2) × (2x + 8)} = √{(8 - 2) × (2 × 8 + 8)} = √(6 × 24) = √144 = 12

**∴ The required result will be 12.**

questions.question: The mean proportional between 35 and a certain number N is four times the mean proportional between 14 and 30. The number N is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Squaring the mean proportional relation directly: 35 × N = 4² × (14 × 30)

⇒ 35 × N = 16 × 420

⇒ N = (16 × 420) ÷ 35

⇒ N = 16 × 12 = 192

**∴ The correct answer is 192.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b26030d7237b4a277e5240f0872fdd554d81df55df7a6afe6745031b89fd97c3.png] 

**Given:**

First pair of numbers = 35 and N

Second pair of numbers = 14 and 30

**Formula Used:**

Mean proportional between a and b = √(a × b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Mean proportional of 35 and N = √(35 × N)

⇒ Mean proportional of 14 and 30 = √(14 × 30) = √420

According to the given condition:

⇒ √(35 × N) = 4 × √420

Squaring both sides of the equation:

⇒ 35 × N = 16 × 420

⇒ N = (16 × 420) ÷ 35

⇒ N = 16 × 12

⇒ N = 192

**∴ The correct answer is 192.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional (or geometric mean) between two given numbers a and b is √(ab).

Third Proportional

If three numbers a, b, and c are in continued proportion (a : b :: b : c), then c is known as the third proportional, given by c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

For three distinct numbers a, b, and c, the fourth proportional x satisfies the condition a : b :: c : x, which is calculated as x = (b × c) ÷ a.

questions.question: The mean proportion of (3 + 2√2)2 and (3 - 2√2)2 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The numbers are (3 + 2√2)² and (3 - 2√2)².

**Formula Used:**

Mean proportion of a and b = √(a×b)

**Calculation:**

First, calculate (3 + 2√2)² and (3 - 2√2)².

⇒ (3 + 2√2)² = 9 + 12√2 + 8 = 17 + 12√2

⇒ (3 - 2√2)² = 9 - 12√2 + 8 = 17 - 12√2

Now, find the mean proportion.

⇒ Mean proportion = √[(17 + 12√2)×(17 - 12√2)]

⇒ Mean proportion = √[(17)² - (12√2)²]

⇒ Mean proportion = √[289 - 288]

⇒ Mean proportion = √1

⇒ Mean proportion = 1

**The mean proportion of (3 + 2√2)² and (3 - 2√2)² is 1.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** 

**Given:**

Numbers = (3 + 2√2)² and (3 − 2√2)²

**Formula used:**

Mean proportion of a and b = √(a × b)

**Shortcut trick:**

Let a = (3 + 2√2)², b = (3 − 2√2)²

⇒ a × b = [(3 + 2√2)(3 − 2√2)]²

⇒ a × b = (9 − (2√2)²)²

⇒ a × b = (9 − 8)² = 1

Mean proportion = √(a × b) = √1 = 1

**∴ Mean proportion = 1**

questions.question: When x is subtracted from each of 24, 30, 36 and 46, the numbers so obtained in this order, are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (2x + 3) and (3x + 2)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

If x is subtracted from each of 24, 30, 36, and 46, the numbers would in proportion. 

**Concepts used:**

Componendo and Dividendo

If p:q :: r:s, then 

Componendo

⇒ (p + q)/q = (r + s)/s

Dividendo

⇒ (p - q)/p = (r - s)/s

Mean Proportional between two numbers a and b = √ab

**Calculation:**

As per the question,

(24 - x)/(30 - x) = (36 - x)/(46 - x)

Using Componendo and Dividendo

⇒ (24 - x + 30 - x)/(24 - x - 30 + x) = (36 - x + 46 - x)/(36 - x - 46 + x)

⇒ (54 - 2x)/(- 6) = (82 - 2x)/(-10) 

⇒ (27 - x)/3 = (41 - x)/5

⇒ 5(27 - x) = 3(41 - x)

⇒ 135 - 5x = 123 - 3x 

⇒ 12 = 2x

⇒ x = 6

**∴ Mean proportional between (2x + 3) and (3x + 2) = √(2x + 3)(3x + 2)**

⇒ √(2 × 6 + 3)(3 × 6 + 2)

⇒ √300 

⇒ 10√3

questions.question: When x is subtracted from each of 21, 22, 60, and 64, the numbers so obtained in this order are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (x + 4) and ((x)/(2) - 1)?
questions.solution:
**To find:-** (x + 4) and ((x)/(2) - 1)

**Calculation:-**

The given question can be solved with the short trick.

Whenever we need to subtract x from the given four numbers group them in two i.e. first two and the last two numbers.

So the numbers will be- 21, 22 and 60, 64. 

Step 1- Take the difference between the first two numbers and the last two numbers i.e. (22 - 21= 1) & (64 - 60= 4)

Step 2- Subtract x from the first number and the third number or the second number and the fourth number.

Step 3- Multiply the former one with 4 and the latter one with 1 and obtain the value of x.

Let's see the mathematical operation-

⇒ (21-x) × 4 = (60-x) × 1

⇒ 84 - 4x = 60 - x

⇒ 24 = 3x

⇒ x=8

Now according to the question, we need to find the mean proportional of- (x + 4) and ((x)/(2) - 1).

⇒sqrt{(x+4){((x)/(2) - 1)}}

⇒ sqrt{12×3}= sqrt36 (By putting the value of x= 8)

⇒ 6

Hence, the value of:- **(x + 4) and ((x)/(2) - 1)= 6**

questions.question: The mean proportion between 17 and some unknown number is 51. What is the unknown number?
questions.solution:
**Formula Used:**

Mean Proportion = √(a × b)

**Calculation:**

We have,

⇒ Mean Proportion = 51

⇒ a = 17

Let the unknown number be b.

⇒ √(17 × b) = 51

Squaring both sides,

⇒ 17 × b = 51²

⇒ 17 × b = 2601

Dividing both sides by 17,

⇒ b = 2601 / 17

⇒ b = 153

**∴ The unknown number is 153.**
